lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg14MnAs is hexagonal, space group P-6m2 (No. 187), with 16 atoms per unit cell across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows As and Mn each coordinated by 12 neighbors, and Mg centers also with 12 neighbors, forming close-packed-like local arrangements. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge- and corner/face-sharing between As- and Mg-centered polyhedra.
